display-welcome.purpose: The welcome screen's single title — the only place the shell speaks loudly.

shell-title.purpose: Panel titles, sidebar project name, dialog headings.

shell-body.purpose: Shell UI text — menus, tabs, tree rows, settings. Never exceeds 14px.

shell-label.purpose: Uppercase sidebar section headers with widened tracking.

reading-heading.purpose: Serif document headings; h1/h2 close with a 1px hairline.

reading-body.purpose: Rendered Markdown — the core identity. User-tunable size and width, serif floor holds.

mono-code.purpose: Source view, diffs, code blocks — JetBrains Mono.

shadows.name: menu-float
shadows.purpose: Dropdown menus and portaled popovers. Dark theme deepens to /0.5 and /0.4.

shadows.name: panel-float
shadows.purpose: Color/icon pickers and small floating cards. Dark theme /0.4.

shadows.name: dialog-halo
shadows.purpose: Login glass card and settings dialog — wide, diffuse, ambient.

shadows.name: modal-depth
shadows.purpose: Diagram zoom modal — the deepest floating layer.

shadows.name: git-panel-veil
shadows.purpose: Left edge of the overlaying git panel.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus-visible ring on activity tiles and icon buttons; primitives use ring-2 ring-offset-2.

motion.name: state-ease
motion.purpose: Hover/focus color and background transitions; globally applied to button/a/input/select/textarea.

motion.name: menu-ease
motion.purpose: Menu open (slide + fade from -4px) and menu-item hover fills.

motion.name: panel-slide
motion.purpose: Drawers, sidebar width, git panel transform.

motion.name: ripple
motion.purpose: Click ripple expanding from center, fading to 0.

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.purpose: Body background/color crossfade on theme switch.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Below this, the dedicated MobileLayout replaces the desktop shell (drawer tree, 40px top bar, fullscreen settings).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The graphite action button for primary moves (save, submit).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font-family: 'MiSans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(var(--primary) / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring)), 0 0 0 4px hsl(var(--background)); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — hairline border on paper, fills paper-gray on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--background)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-family: 'MiSans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(var(--secondary)); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring)), 0 0 0 4px hsl(var(--background)); }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Borderless 36×36 icon button — the shell's default quiet action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: hsl(var(--secondary)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring)); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: 36px text input — paper-gray fill, hairline border, ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--secondary)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-family: 'MiSans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring) / 0.2); border-color: hsl(var(--ring)); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Menu Panel
components.description: The unified popup menu — popover card with tint-hover items, separator, destructive item, count badge.
components.css: .ds-menu { min-width: 180px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--popover)); color: hsl(var(--popover-foreground)); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); font-family: 'MiSans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; animation: ds-menu-in 0.12s ease; } @keyframes ds-menu-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px) scale(0.98); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } } .ds-menu-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 6px 10px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: inherit; font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: background-color 0.12s ease; } .ds-menu-item:hover, .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { background: hsl(var(--secondary)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); outline: none; } .ds-menu-item-destructive, .ds-menu-item-destructive:hover { color: hsl(var(--destructive)); } .ds-menu-item-destructive:hover { background: hsl(var(--destructive) / 0.1); } .ds-menu-separator { height: 1px; margin: 4px; background: hsl(var(--border)); } .ds-menu-badge { margin-left: auto; background: hsl(var(--accent)); color: hsl(var(--accent-foreground)); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 10px; min-width: 18px; text-align: center; }

components.name: View Tabs
components.description: Preview / Source / Diff — tint pill + 60%-width accent underline grows from center on the active tab.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; font-family: 'MiSans', sans-serif; } .ds-tab { position: relative; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; background: none; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-tab::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -1px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 0; height: 2px; background: hsl(var(--accent)); border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0; transition: width 0.2s ease; } .ds-tab:hover { background: hsl(var(--card)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-tab-active { background: hsl(var(--accent) / 0.08); color: hsl(var(--accent)); font-weight: 500; } .ds-tab-active::after { width: 60%; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring)); }

components.name: Activity Bar Project Tiles
components.description: 52px rail tiles — 40×40 project squares; active = accent tint + accent border + accent text.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 0; width: 52px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, hsl(var(--background)) 0%, hsl(var(--secondary)) 100%); border-right: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); } .ds-tile { width: 40px; height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 8px; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); opacity: 0.7; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-tile:hover { background: hsl(var(--muted)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring)); } .ds-tile-active { background: hsl(var(--accent) / 0.08); color: hsl(var(--accent)); border-color: hsl(var(--accent)); opacity: 1; } .ds-tile-initial { font-family: 'MiSans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Login Glass Card
components.description: Signature — the one moment of atmosphere: 20px glass card over a diagonal wash gradient with an accent radial.
components.html:
O

OpenMKView

Local Markdown, beautifully read
components.css: .ds-login-scene { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 24px; background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, hsl(var(--accent) / 0.14), transparent 32%), linear-gradient(160deg, hsl(var(--background)) 0%, hsl(var(--muted)) 100%); } .ds-login { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: min(420px, 100%); padding: 28px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border) / 0.9); background: hsl(var(--background) / 0.88); box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); } .ds-login-mark { width: 52px; height: 52px; flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 16px; background: hsl(var(--accent)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font-family: 'MiSans', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-login-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'MiSans', sans-serif; font-size: 28px; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-login-sub { margin: 6px 0 0; font-family: 'MiSans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); }

components.name: Reading Room Block
components.description: Signature — the serif reading pane: Georgia 16/1.7, hairline-ruled h1/h2, washed code block, quoted rule.
components.html:
The Quiet Reading Room

Two rooms, one door

The shell is a cool, colorless instrument. Cross into the document pane and the room changes character — Georgia serif at a generous line-height, where the file is the only voice.

Shadows belong exclusively to things that float.
cargo run
components.css: .ds-reading { max-width: 720px; padding: 16px; font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif', serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-rh1 { margin: 1.5em 0 0.5em; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; padding-bottom: 0.3em; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); } .ds-rh2 { margin: 1.5em 0 0.5em; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; padding-bottom: 0.3em; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); } .ds-rp { margin-bottom: 1em; } .ds-rquote { margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 3px solid hsl(var(--border)); color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-rpre { position: relative; margin-bottom: 1em; padding: 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); background: hsl(var(--muted)); overflow-x: auto; } .ds-rpre code { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.northStar: The Quiet Reading Room（静谧阅览室）
narrative.overview:
OpenMKView is two rooms with one door. The shell — activity bar, file tree, tabs, panels — is a cool, colorless instrument: zinc-gray steel, hairline borders, 13px sans labels, everything measured and quiet. Cross into the document pane and the room changes character: Georgia serif at 16px/1.7, generous leading, headings that rule themselves off with a hairline — a warm study where the file is the only voice. The system's job is to make that transition feel like walking from a workshop into a library, without either room raising its voice.

The temperament is calm restraint (冷静克制) and precision-instrument (精密工具感): monochrome by default, tint pills instead of fills, shadows only where surfaces float. The long-game goal is durability (耐看长期主义) — this is a daily tool that must not tire — with the warmth of a study (温润书房感) reserved for the reading experience. Interactive components are quiet at rest but answer the hand: ripple and press-scale feedback make every touch land, then settle back to silence.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome zinc scale; the default accent is graphite on paper (light) / chalk on night (dark) — hue only enters through the four ink variants or semantic tokens.
Two typefaces by room: MiSans shell, Georgia reading pane, JetBrains Mono for code — they never mix.
State language is tonal: hover = accent at 8% alpha, active/selected = 12%, plus a 2px accent underline for the active tab. New colors are never invented for states.
Flat docked surfaces separated by 1px hairlines; shadows exist only on floating layers (menus, dialogs, drawers, toasts).
Compact tool density on desktop (40px tiles, 46px header, ~24px tree rows); mobile is a first-class citizen with its own drawer-based layout, not a shrunken desktop.

rules.name: The Ink-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Hue enters the system only as poured ink — one of the four theme variants, or a semantic token (cinnabar/jade/amber). The default system is colorless; any new colored surface must justify itself as ink or it stays gray.

rules.name: The 8/12 Tint Rule
rules.body: Hover is accent / 0.08; active and selected are accent / 0.12. States are tints of existing tokens, never new colors, and never full-opacity fills.

rules.name: The Two Rooms Rule
rules.body: MiSans never renders inside the document pane; Georgia never renders in the shell. The font switch is the door between workshop and library — blurring it dissolves the identity.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a surface is docked, it has no shadow — it gets a hairline. Shadows are the visual proof that something floats; using them for emphasis on a docked panel breaks the physics of the room.

dos: Do express every hover/selected state as an accent tint at 8% / 12% alpha — the tint pill is the system's state language.
Do separate regions with 1px hairlines on the border token; halve opacity only when a divider must recede.
Do keep the reading pane serif, 16px, 1.7 line-height, with hairline-ruled h1/h2 — it is the core identity (核心身份).
Do use 0.15s ease for state transitions, 0.12s for menus, cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for panel slides, and always answer presses with ripple/scale.
Do keep focus-visible rings (2px, ring token, offset 2) on every interactive element — keyboard users get the same precision.
Do build mobile as the drawer-based MobileLayout with safe-area insets and 16px form text; never shrink the desktop shell.
donts: Don't introduce hue outside the four inks and three semantic tokens — gray is the default, color is a decision.
Don't put shadows on docked panels; a shadow claims "I float."
Don't render MiSans inside the document pane or Georgia in the shell — the typeface switch is the room switch.
Don't exceed the radius scale (4/6/8/12/16, 20 for the login card) or the shell text ceiling (14px).
Don't replace tint fills with saturated solids for hover/active states, and don't animate state changes slower than 0.3s.
